adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and passes it directly into `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no upper bound. This allows a public request like `/groups/<name>/members.json?limit=1000000` to attempt fetching and serializing an excessively large number of users, creating a realistic performance/DoS risk. The previous code also used a param-derived limit but only in the `automatic?` branch; this change makes it apply to all groups and still lacks clamping.
